closures: Umm Qays: Winter column (labelled November through April): 08:00-16:00; summer: 08:00-18:30; separate April-May column: 08:00-17:30; Ramadan: 09:00-17:00. The April columns overlap, so confirm the applicable seasonal timetable with the site. Saraya Museum in Irbid has a separate winter 08:00-17:00 and summer 08:00-19:00 timetable; Fridays and official holidays 10:00-16:00 in those columns. Its April-May column says 08:00-17:30 and Ramadan 09:00-17:00; confirm which exception takes priority during Ramadan.
